determinism_note: v1.0 froze only 'applies to fixture', so a later recipe could have mutated whichever of a fixture's three products, six retrieval occurrences or three outputs was easiest -- post-hoc selection at the branch level. Target selection is now EXHAUSTIVE over an explicitly counted population, so the recipe author has no remaining choice.

outcome_rules.when: mutation did not change the fixture, evaluator did not run, or reset unverified

outcome_rules.note: ADDED IN v1.1. A registered fault the fixtures do not detect. v1.0 had no outcome for this.
ADDED IN v1.1. R11 must be inert; detecting it means the evaluator reads presentation.

trial_level_consequence: Any assurance_failed in a qualifying run yields trial outcome mutation_assurance_failed. NO model verdict may be issued from a run whose evaluator does not detect its registered faults.

fixture_requirements.requirement: Every fixture declares all four temporal bounds with an explicit value and bound_state.
Every fixture reports evidence_state, verification_result and execution_status as three separate fields.
MANDATORY presentation-only field ftro:display_name on every entity, read by NO query.
fixture_requirements.note: ADDED IN v1.1. v1.0 registered R11 as a display-name mutation without requiring fixtures to contain a display name, so R11 was not guaranteed executable. Absence of this field makes R11 not_executed, which fails the run.
